notes: www.sliceit.com/careers 301s to slice.bank.in/careers, which links /careers/open-positions and embeds the Kula board https://careers.kula.ai/slice?jobs=true. Membership comes from GET https://careers.kula.ai/api/internal/ats_job_posts?accountName=slice&page=1&type=ats_job_post.index&items=99 (meta.count=34). Department/location vocabulary comes from GET .../ats_job_posts/filter_options?accountName=slice&type=ats_job_post.filter_options. The UI selects (All departments / All locations) filter the already-loaded rows client-side: adding department_id=8516 to the listing request left the result at 34 rows, so no native filter parameter is claimed.
